turns.say: Can you show me on the TV a block sliding down a ramp, and the forces on it?
turns.expect: Muse uses the wall TV: a block on an inclined ramp with its weight (gravity) and the normal force drawn, the block sliding down; Muse explains by voice.

The TV DRAWING changes within a few seconds: the ramp's angle becomes visibly larger (steeper incline) and the force picture/speed follows (bigger component down the slope). Not just a caption change. Muse says in a few words what changed.
The TV picture changes again: a friction force arrow pointing UP the slope (opposite the motion) appears and the block slides more slowly; the steeper ramp is kept.
